import re

def parse_grids(text):
    found=[]
    pat=re.compile(r'(Test input|Demo pair \d+ input|Demo pair \d+ output) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n')
    for m in pat.finditer(text):
        h,w=int(m.group(2)),int(m.group(3)); lines=text[m.end():].splitlines()[:h]
        grid=[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in lines]
        assert len(grid)==h and all(len(row)==w for row in grid),(m.group(1),len(grid),[len(x) for x in grid])
        found.append((m.group(1),grid))
    return found
parsed=[parse_grids(t) for t in texts]
for row in parsed: print([(name,len(g),len(g[0])) for name,g in row])

from collections import Counter

def infer_matrix(grid):
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows=[]; row_colors=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        color,n=Counter(row).most_common(1)[0]
        if color!=bg and n>=len(row)*0.5:
            rows.append(i); row_colors.append(color)
    cols=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[i][j]!=c for i,c in zip(rows,row_colors))]
    mat=[[grid[i][j] for j in cols] for i in rows]
    return bg,rows,row_colors,cols,mat
for pair_idx in [1,2]:
    g=parsed[pair_idx][0][1]
    print('pair',pair_idx, 'bg',infer_matrix(g)[:4])

source='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    data_rows = []
    row_colors = []
    for index, row in enumerate(grid):
        color, count = Counter(row).most_common(1)[0]
        if color != background and count >= len(row) * 0.5:
            data_rows.append(index)
            row_colors.append(color)

    data_cols = [
        col for col in range(len(grid[0]))
        if any(grid[row][col] != color for row, color in zip(data_rows, row_colors))
    ]
    matrix = [[grid[row][col] for col in data_cols] for row in data_rows]
    if len(matrix) > 1 and len(set(matrix[-1])) == 1:
        matrix = matrix[:-1]

    return [
        [
            matrix[row][col]
            if matrix[row][col] == matrix[row][col + 1] == matrix[row + 1][col] == matrix[row + 1][col + 1]
            else background
            for col in range(len(matrix[0]) - 1)
        ]
        for row in range(len(matrix) - 1)
    ]
'''
